note: the same re-issuance in public mode (empty UUID): updates 1 and 3 disclose the same state, so they have the same BLID. keripy's vetBinds matches disclosures to updates by BLID from a detached list and refuses two matches (UnverifiedBlindError). In the stream each disclosure is attached to its own bup, so it is unambiguous; a reader that binds by attachment accepts it. Writers should use a fresh UUID per update (v2-reissued)
